subject.title: feat(slack): allow configurable App Home views

question: Should OpenClaw support file-backed Slack App Home configuration, or keep this feature inline and canonical-config only?
rationale: The no-restart file path creates a permanent config contract and request-time filesystem dependency that conflicts with repository lifecycle guidance.

options.title: Inline config only
options.body: Keep appHome.view, remove viewPath, and use the normal config reload or Gateway restart lifecycle.

options.title: Lifecycle-loaded file
options.body: Retain viewPath but load and validate it during an explicit startup or owner reload flow.

options.title: Accept event-time reload
options.body: Keep per-event reads only with explicit ownership of the resulting latency and availability risk.

recommendation.title: Inline config only
recommendation.body: Keep appHome.view, remove viewPath, and use the normal config reload or Gateway restart lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Slack App Home implementation was introduced in this person's recent merged work.
